{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values of severity to confirm 'severe' exists
print('Unique severity levels:', df['severity'].unique())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Number of duplicates (rows > 1 per patient):', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check if there are rows with sample_seq > 1 (re-tests)
retested_patients = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print('\nNumber of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1):', len(retested_patients))

# Check for any patient_id with multiple sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print('\nMax sample_seq per patient:', patient_sample_counts.max())

# Confirm that we need to deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq
# (i.e., at least one patient has sample_seq > 1)
print('\nPatients with multiple sample_seq (should be 24):', (patient_sample_counts > 1).sum())"}
